CITY OF ALHAMBRA
  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD | MINUTES
  REGULAR MEETING – 7:30 P.M.
  City Hall Conference Room A
  111 South First Street

August 22, 2023

A. CALL MEETING TO ORDER: 7:30 P.M.

B. ROLL CALL:

Present:
ANKIT UDANI, CHAIRMAN
NORA HERNANDEZ, VICE CHAIRMAN
STANLEY TSAI, MEMBER
MICHAEL DANINGER, MEMBER
STEVE KUCHENSKI, SECRETARY

C. CONSENT CALENDAR:

All items listed under Consent Calendar are considered by the Design Review Board to
be routine and will be enacted by one motion unless a citizen or Board Member requests
otherwise; in which case, the item will be removed for separate consideration.

ITEM 1:  MINUTES: July 25, 2023
ITEM 2:  MINUTES: August 8, 2023

MOTION:
  • Chairman Udani moved to approve all consent items.
  • The second was by Board Member Daninger.
  • The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Daninger, Tsai, Hernandez
  Noes:  None

D. DISCUSSION ITEMS:

ITEM 3:  528 North Ethel Avenue

  •  This is an application for exterior improvements and remodel of an existing
  detached 2-car garage located in the rear and visible from the side street Alhambra
  Road.
  •  Applicant: Cheryl Simmons
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVAL WITH CONDITIONS - The proposed project
  is approved with Conditions of Approval.

  1
   •  Discussion: Applicant was present. Vice Chair Hernandez asked for clarification of
  city staff’s condition. City Architect responded by stating the condition is to ensure
  the drawings state exact language on the drawings for roof type. Hernandez
  agreed.

MOTION:

  •  Hernandez moved to approve the application with the following conditions: 1)
  Revise roof specification on Sheet 3.0, to identify the roof material as a ‘true 2-
  piece system mission barrel roofing tile’. To ensure the roof type and product
  matches the existing house; and 2) City Architect is responsible to verify and
  approve the revised roof specification.
  •  The second was by Chairman Udani.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Daninger, Tsai, Hernandez
  Noes:  None

ITEM 4:  726 East Valley Boulevard

  •  This is an application for exterior sign improvements and re-painting of an existing
  canopy on an existing 1-story commercial Wells Fargo bank building.
  •  Applicant: Alex Clements, Pattison Sign Group
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVAL WITH CONDITIONS - The proposed project
  is approved with Conditions of Approval.
  •  Discussion: Applicant was absent. Board Members continued the discussion.
  Board Member Daninger stated that no dimensions are shown for the height of the
  proposed signage. Daninger continued stating the dimension needs to be with
  respect to the ground floor or building height.

MOTION:

  •  Board Member Daninger moved to approve the application with the following
  conditions: 1) The proposed signage shall stay true to the sign character, scale,
  style and quality as shown in the proposed elevations; 2) If there are any changes,
  modifications, or alterations to the proposed signage, the applicant must re-submit
  for City Architect to verify and approve; and 3) Revise drawings to show a height
  dimension for proposed signage form grade level to bottom of signage.
  •  The second was by Board Member Tsai.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Daninger, Tsai, Hernandez
  Noes:  None

ITEM 5:  1839 West Valley Boulevard

  •  This is an application for new exterior improvements and interior remodel of an
  existing single-story commercial fast-food Wendy’s restaurant.
  •  Applicant: Irfan Boukai, Coastline Design & Construction Inc
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVAL WITH CONDITIONS - The proposed project
  is approved with Conditions of Approval.

  2
   •  Discussion: Applicant and Architect were present. Board Member Daninger started
  that no dimensions are shown for the height of the proposed signage. Daninger
  continued stating the dimension needs to be with respect to the ground floor or
  building height. Vice Chairman Hernandez second and asked if a Sign Program is
  required for the project. Hernandez stated that a building with multiple tenants
  require a sign program and asked Staff if this should be required prior to making a
  motion. Staff answered by stating the property is currently separate parcels with
  one separate tenant, and the applicant wishes to conduct a lot merger or lot tie for
  the property. Staff stated that the project does not require a sign program at this
  time and is recommended to be reviewed without a sign program in place. Udani
  mentioned that all signs on the project should provide specific details for each,
  including a dimension for height with respect to the ground. Daninger stated that a
  note or detail needs to be shown for all three signs not just a typical detail and note
  because each sign appears to be different size and scale in elevation.

MOTION:

  •  Vice Chairman Hernandez moved to approve the application with the following
  conditions: 1) The applicant upholds the architectural character, style, and quality
  of exterior signage and canopy as shown in the approved set of drawings,
  specifications, and color and material board; 2) Any change, modification, or
  alteration to the exterior signage and/or canopy, as it relates to the architectural
  character, style, and/or quality, the applicant must re-submit the plan set for the
  City Architect to review for approval; and 3) Revise drawings to show the specific
  height of all proposed signage with respect to the ground level. The dimensions
  may be shown in elevation or a separate wall section.
  •  The second was by Board Member Daninger.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani. Daninger, Tsai, Hernandez
  Noes:  None

E. ADJOURNMENT:

  •  We will adjourn to the next meeting on August 22, 2023.

MOTION:

  •  Chair Udani moved to adjourn the meeting at 9:00 P.M.
  •  The second was by Board Member Tsai
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Daninger, Tsai, Hernandez
  Noes:  None

ATTEST:

_____________________
Steve Kuchenski
Secretary
